Prevention: Avoid the movement of infected planting materials
Use disease free clean planting materials
Jik, especially when cutting cassava stems into planting materials
Intercropping cassava with maize/ cowpeas reduces the whiteflies, a key vector to the spread of
Monitoring: CBSD regularly; checking mature (lower) leaves for yellow and green patches, stems for streak lines and storage roots for dark staining of the fresh root.
Check the presence of vectors (white fly) populations in the plantation.
If you notice any affected plant, immediately uproot and destroy by burying or burning
Direct Control (Non-chemical): Uproot and destroy the infected plants
Direct Control (Chemical): The use of pesticides to control vectors is discouraged
not only do most of them kill natural enemies, whiteflies quickly build up resistance to them
and many are not very effective in garden situations
